tools.name: falpha_signal_desk_card
tools.description: [Signal Desk] fAlpha's current model reading on one ticker, computed by quantitative models from numerical market data (no language model sets the number): the equity indicator (EI, signed: positive leans long, negative leans short) and the driver carrying the reading for the requested horizon and r

tools.name: falpha_signal_desk_compare
tools.description: [Signal Desk] Two tickers side by side on the current signal, with which of the two carries the stronger reading (`stronger`; EI magnitudes within 0.05 of each other are `comparable`). For questions like 'AAPL or MSFT'; falpha_screener_desk ranks more than two names. Available without an account.

tools.name: falpha_signal_desk_history
tools.description: [Signal Desk] The signal and its drivers stored for a past date (the newest reading on or before it). For questions like 'what did the model say in June'; falpha_signal_desk_performance covers a date range. Requires a connected fAlpha account.

tools.name: falpha_signal_desk_performance
tools.description: [Signal Desk] How a ticker moved over a date range against a benchmark, and the excess return taken in the direction of the signal on the range's first day. One reading held over one window: a realized outcome, not a forecast. For questions like 'was the model right on TSLA this quarter'. Requires a

tools.name: falpha_signal_desk_flips
tools.description: [Signal Desk] The dates the signal changed direction (long to short or back) over a lookback window, the drivers at each change, and the current direction. For questions like 'when did the model turn bearish on TSLA'. Requires a connected fAlpha account.

tools.name: falpha_signal_desk_curve
tools.description: [Signal Desk] The model's term structure for a ticker: the equity indicator's direction from one day out to six months, the curve's shape (strengthening, weakening or flipping), whether the sign changes across horizons, and near/mid/long summary legs, each marked `mixed` when its points lean both wa

tools.name: falpha_screener_desk
tools.description: [Screener Desk] Ranks fAlpha's covered universe (5k+ US equities) by the current signal, either the equity indicator or the signal's realized Sharpe ratio, filtered by direction, sector or a minimum Sharpe ratio. Names that share the top value are listed by ticker and the result says how many share

tools.name: falpha_screener_desk_coverage
tools.description: [Screener Desk] Whether a ticker is in fAlpha's covered universe, with its sector and latest signal date, or a page through the universe. The other desks return no data for tickers outside it. Available without an account.

tools.name: falpha_sentiment_desk
tools.description: [Sentiment Desk] fAlpha's daily news sentiment score for a ticker, with the articles it was computed from and the date of the reading. For questions like 'what is the news saying about AMZN'; falpha_sentiment_desk_trend covers how it has moved. Available without an account.

tools.name: falpha_sentiment_desk_trend
tools.description: [Sentiment Desk] How news sentiment has moved over a window: the current reading (the newest scored day, with its date and article count), the change since the window opened, the direction, the high/low band and the daily series. For questions about the trajectory rather than the latest score. Avail

tools.name: falpha_analyst_desk
tools.description: [Analyst Desk] Sell-side coverage for a ticker: recent price-target calls with source links, an accuracy-weighted consensus lean, and each analyst's historical hit rate, including their accuracy when agreeing and when disagreeing with the fAlpha model. Covered universe only. Requires a connected fAl

tools.name: falpha_glossary
tools.description: [Glossary] The fAlpha definition of a term the desks return: EI (equity indicator), drivers, Sharpe, Sortino, percent_positive_pnl, signal flip, term structure. Not metered. Available without an account.

tools.name: falpha_filings_scout
tools.description: [Filings Scout] Recent SEC filings for a ticker from SEC EDGAR (10-K, 10-Q and 8-K by default), newest first, each with its filing date and document URL. Requires a connected fAlpha account; not included in the free trial.

tools.name: falpha_filings_scout_facts
tools.description: [Filings Scout] Reported fundamentals from SEC XBRL filings: revenue, net income, diluted EPS, total assets, total liabilities and stockholders' equity, for the latest reported quarters and fiscal years, each with its period end and filing date. The filing is the source of record. Requires a connect

tools.name: falpha_macro_desk
tools.description: [Macro Desk] The US macro backdrop from FRED: the fed funds rate (DFF), CPI (CPIAUCSL), unemployment (UNRATE), the 10y-2y spread (T10Y2Y) and the 10-year yield (DGS10). One series returns its recent history; with no series the full bundle is returned. Requires a connected fAlpha account; not include

tools.name: falpha_fundamentals_desk
tools.description: [Fundamentals Desk] Company profile and trailing-twelve-month ratios from FMP: sector, market cap, P/E, margins, debt/equity. Third-party reference data, not fAlpha model output. Requires a connected fAlpha account; not included in the free trial.

tools.name: falpha_open_in_web
tools.description: [Your Record] Links to the fAlpha website and the user's account page, where plan, usage and billing are shown. For questions about the user's fAlpha plan, usage, billing or account. Not metered. Available without an account.
